title: Settlement Fee on the Marketplace Orders Replacement Charge
content:
**Table rule.** The settlement fee of the Marketplace Orders replacement charge follows the overdue-day count: at least the long-overdue days of 14 pay the per-day settlement fee of USD 0.50 once for every overdue day; at least the short-overdue days of 7 but fewer than 14 pay one flat short-overdue fee of USD 3.50; fewer overdue days pay no settlement fee.

The settlement fee is added to the replacement charge. Overdue days are calendar days counted from the unreturned-replacement deadline, which is the date recorded on the replacement entry plus the option's unreturned replacement days.

| Overdue days | Settlement fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 to 6 | 0.00 |
| 7 | 3.50 |
| 13 | 3.50 |
| 14 | 14 times 0.50, that is 7.00 |
| 20 | 20 times 0.50, that is 10.00 |

## Points of judgement

- At exactly 7 overdue days the flat USD 3.50 applies.
- At exactly 14 overdue days the per-day rule applies to every overdue day: USD 7.00.
- Between 7 and 13 days the fee stays USD 3.50 whatever the number of days.
